integrity: Direct probability argument supported by symbolic exact integrals, finite exhaustive verification and independently reproducible standalone checking; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim is a joint weak Gaussian limit with asymptotic independence and exact finite covariance; no convergence rates or total-variation independence. Prior multivariate generating functions determine all finite mixed moments, and the finite covariance identity alone is not claimed novel. Residual historical-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Asymptotic independence of crossing and nesting counts despite exact negative finite-size covariance
